inclusions.normalization_rationale: The Cancun upgrade spec was created with EIP-4844 as its sole "Included" EIP on the day of ACD call #151, whose written summary records: "We agreed that EIP-4844 should be included in the fork after Shanghai, to reflect how the CL specs are right now... for now I'll create cancun.md and list EIP-4844 as Included." In the 2022-2023 process, "Included" in the pre-activation upgrade spec meant client teams had committed to ship the EIP in the upgrade, i.e. what later vocabulary calls Scheduled for Inclusion. EIP-4844's earlier consideration for Shanghai (it appeared in shanghai.md's CFI list, removed by this same commit) is a Shanghai fork relationship and is not modeled as a Cancun event. Note: the minutes file header misdates the call to 2022-11-10; the agenda issue and matching YouTube link establish 2022-12-08 (see pm-issue-675).
